notes: (1) I opened by stating the sitting: the three casts at the corners of a triangle, Arman on the F–Φ edge in T's light, saying how the roles of T stand in the roles of F and of Φ, and nothing of F to Φ. I laid out the roles (label, gloss) and the words of F, Φ and T as the files give them. (2) Before any relating, he asked that every possible relating, each role of T with each role of F or of Φ (72 F-T and 63 Φ-T pairs, 135 in all), be put to him as a question box answered in batches, with the box designed first. He stated that his word supersedes the commission. (3) The box, which he approved: the pair with the T role as subject and the F or Φ role as object, each with label, id and gloss from the files; his word typed between the two; holds or does not hold, with no default; an optional why; a further line for another relating of the same pair; an empty box meaning nothing said for that pair; a live line showing what would be recorded. It was shown as an interactive form in the chat. Each batch came back as one message; I read every relating back in one line, with the pairs left empty, and wrote only what he confirmed. (4) He chose batches by role of T, beginning with the hold and following the order of the table: hold, own, living refrain, marking refrain, assuming, other, pace, broken hold, line of flight. That made nine batches of fifteen boxes, with the T role's gloss shown once at the top of each. (5) Words are kept exactly as he typed them, dots included. In batch 1 I pointed out the spelling 'might.appeare.as' (T:hold to F:ambient), and he confirmed it as typed. In batch 3, where 'might.appear.as' first appeared, I noted that the record now held both spellings; he confirmed without change, so both stand. (6) While batch 3 was open, he asked why the box fixes the T role as subject, and whether the reverse pairing, a role of F or Φ said of a role of T, would come at the sittings where F or Φ is the projected corner. I explained that this sitting is in T's light, where T speaks of the two ends, so every relating runs from a role of T. By the same logic, the reverse direction would belong to F's light or Φ's light, which this commission does not cover. He kept the subject fixed and asked that the report state that the relations here have only one direction for now: from the roles of T to the roles of F and of Φ. (7) All nine batches were confirmed: 39 relatings (33 hold, 6 do not hold) on 36 of the 135 pairs, with nothing said for the other 99. Every role of T has at least one relating. (8) At the end I asked once whether any role of T was to be listed as silent. He said he did not understand the question and asked me to wrap up the report. No role was named, so silent is empty. (9) At his word, the report also went to the researcher's inbox as .handoff\inbox\researcher\2026-10-08_1800_scribe_the-verdict-widget.md, with the time taken from the clock by running date. Beyond the three cast files, the only thing read was the display tool's own styling guide for the widget, and the only command run was date, at his word.
